name: Rinus Michels
scopeNote: Manager profile of Rinus Michels across three counted spells: Ajax (22 January 1965 to 30 June 1971: four Eredivisie titles and the 1970-71 European Cup), Barcelona (1 July 1971 to 30 June 1975: La Liga 1973-74) and the Netherlands (27 March to 7 July 1974: World Cup runner-up). Dates are from the managerial table of the English Wikipedia article (day precision). Excluded: Ajax 1975-76, Barcelona 1976-78 (Copa del Rey 1977-78, not read for tactics), and later spells in the USA, Köln, Leverkusen and the Netherlands in 1984-92. Style: the evidence supports total football at Ajax: a fluid 4-3-3 with positional interchange, the offside trap and high pressing. Barcelona's own tactics are not documented in the pages read.
